svg.title: 2. Spectral Kalman forecasting
svg.desc: Schematic. Top: each band's clock runs over the same range but advances at a different time: the low band mostly early, the mid band in the middle, the high band late, so equal step gaps are different time gaps per band. Bottom: a Kalman filter keeps a value and a damped rate for one coefficient. On skipped steps it forecasts (blue) and its uncertainty widens; at the next computed step (orange) it is corrected with the observed value.
svg.text: Low bands change early, high bands late
A Kalman filter tracks one coefficient
